reviewMethod: Source review of native Harborline NPC/shop pilot against official S1API Forked 3.2.2 public API, successful GitHub Actions compile, package assembly and all 36 repository tests. No Schedule I game runtime or user save was available; in-game behavior remains unverified.

statusLegend.implemented_code_unverified_runtime: Code exists and builds, but target-game execution is not confirmed.
statusLegend.design_only: Requirements/data exist as a plan or configuration, not executable runtime behavior.
statusLegend.not_implemented: No connected implementation exists in this repository.
statusLegend.blocked_unverified_api: The public registration/integration path has not been established from the inspected API.
statusLegend.not_verified_in_game: Requires the installed game, save data, or runtime output.

requirements.requirement: Create functional native buildings and enterable interiors.
evidence: Prototype warehouse is a collection of cubes; no S1API Building registration or S1MAPI BuildingBuilder/InteriorBuilder runtime integration.
requirements.remaining: Replace prototype shell with verified native prefabs/building registration and functional, navigable interiors.

requirements.requirement: Survey map, building, property, NPC, door, navigation, police and networking APIs.
requirements.remaining: Inspect the report from the user's installed game; source-level reflection inventory does not confirm that any specific gameplay hook works.

requirements.requirement: Find candidate S1MAPI prefabs and report their component/network status without spawning them.
requirements.remaining: Validate that Find() resolves the documented prefab names and that IL2CPP component inspection reports reliable network status in game.

requirements.requirement: Read existing native region, building, property, business and phone-map registries.
requirements.remaining: Run in game and inspect row counts/errors and actual shop/item IDs; all added exports are read-only snapshots. Public property/business managers still only enumerate existing registrations.

requirements.requirement: Create working native doors and interactive objects.
evidence: Prefab catalog only looks up references; no Instantiate or InstantiateNetworked path is called.
requirements.remaining: Verify actual prefab components, host/server spawn path, interactions, client operation and save/load.

requirements.requirement: Show correct native building/shop/business/owned-property icons on the normal game map.
evidence: No map canvas extension, map bounds/world transform, native building classification registration or ownership-driven icon update is connected.
requirements.remaining: Discover and verify map projection and registration APIs in the target game; standalone MapPOI is not a substitute.

requirements.requirement: Host-authoritative synchronized geometry, NPCs, doors, stock and interactions.
evidence: Current physical generator deliberately refuses to run unless S1API.Entities.Player.All contains exactly one player.
requirements.remaining: Implement networked generation/spawn and persistence before enabling co-op.

requirements.requirement: Generate each NPC appearance with the game's own appearance generator and preserve it.
evidence: src/Runtime/HarborlineNpcRoster.cs: OnCreated calls Appearance.GenerateRandomAppearance() then Appearance.Build() once for each new NPC
requirements.remaining: Verify rendered avatars, unique appearances, save/load retention and late-join behavior in the target game.

requirements.requirement: Implement 30 customer profiles with product/effect preferences mapped to real product IDs.
evidence: HarborlineNpcRoster.cs: eight native CustomerDataBuilder profiles with distinct spending, orders/week, preferred day/time, standards, police probability, dependence and DrugType affinities.
requirements.remaining: Eight of 30 planned customer profiles are implemented; 22 remain. Map preferences to actual game product/effect IDs where required and test native order generation and customer evaluation in game.

requirements.requirement: Create two physical Harborline player-dealer NPCs with native dealer recruitment, contracts and relationship behavior.
evidence: WithDealerDefaults: PlayerDealer, signing fees, dealer cuts, quality filters and completed-deals variables
WithRelationshipDefaults plus native Dealer.OnRecruited, OnContractAccepted and OnRecommended handlers
requirements.remaining: Confirm both dealers spawn, display in world, can be approached/recruited, accept contracts, sell to assigned customers and retain state after save/load. The two current pilot dealers do not yet have fully designed Harborline dialogue or schedules.

requirements.requirement: Spawn 42 physical native NPCs, initially activate about 18, with 2 dealers.
evidence: src/Runtime/HarborlineNpcRoster.cs: two native PlayerDealer NPC subclasses and eight physical Customer NPC subclasses.
HarborlineNpcRegistrar registers ten stable IDs through S1API after CustomNpcsReady; NPC.Get(id) prevents duplicate creation.
HarborlinePhysicalBuilder supplies ten measured spawn slots from the same candidate footprint.
requirements.remaining: Ten of 42 target NPCs are implemented (2 dealers + 8 customers); 32 remain. Confirm all ten spawn at valid walkable positions, native dialogue/customer ordering, save/load and schedule behavior in the target game.

requirements.requirement: Use native NPC schedules and allow NPCs to enter buildings.
evidence: src/Runtime/HarborlineNpcRoster.cs enables native Schedule engine on created physical NPCs
requirements.remaining: Schedule.Enable() starts the native scheduler, but no daily movement/building actions are configured. This needs measured navmesh positions, native doors and registered interiors before routes can be enabled.

requirements.requirement: Produce installable Thunderstore package with matching dependencies/version.
requirements.remaining: Check package installation in a clean profile with the exact dependency versions and target game build.

requirements.requirement: Save/load custom world geometry and gameplay state without duplication.
evidence: Unity geometry is session-local; last-generation.json is diagnostic output only, not a save integration.
requirements.remaining: Use native saveable objects or an explicit mod save-data lifecycle; verify reload, transition and crash recovery.

requirements.requirement: Native police checks, patrol and dispatch coverage across Harborline.
evidence: No runtime police dispatcher, patrol or checkpoint integration is present in src/.
requirements.remaining: Discover and test the native Docks police coverage, dispatch and checkpoint hooks in the target game.

requirements.requirement: Register purchasable businesses/properties in the native Realtor and ownership systems.
evidence: S1API PropertyManager and BusinessManager expose GetAll/GetOwned/Find enumeration methods; no additive custom registration method has been established.
requirements.remaining: Find a supported native registration hook in installed game APIs/source or implement using a verified game extension point. Do not list sites as purchasable until this works.

requirements.requirement: MelonLoader mod loads and subscribes to native save/scene lifecycle.
requirements.remaining: Run the packaged DLL in the target Schedule I installation and confirm lifecycle log messages.

requirements.requirement: Prove in-game objects appear in the correct positions and all systems work.
evidence: CI compile and static tests only; no user game log, diagnostics folder or runtime screenshot was provided.
requirements.remaining: Run in the actual Schedule I installation and inspect diagnostic files, logs, generated placement and gameplay behavior.

requirements.requirement: Extend an existing native Schedule I shop with additional game items and prices using native purchase UI.
evidence: ItemManager.GetDefinition resolves existing vanilla StorableItemDefinition IDs.
Sets StorableItemDefinition.BasePurchasePrice before ensuring the native shop listing with Shop.AddItem(item).
Current S1API 3.2.2 ShopIntegration ignores the customPrice argument; the plugin does not rely on that unsupported argument.
requirements.remaining: Verify each ID in the installed game, confirm displayed and charged prices, and check all other vanilla shops that sell these same item IDs. BasePurchasePrice belongs to the shared item definition, so the configured price applies globally wherever that ID is sold. This still modifies Hardware Store rather than creating a new Harborline storefront.

requirements.requirement: Physical shops and Hyland Network online orders share inventory/catalogue.
evidence: No Harborline phone order route or shared inventory/order handler is present in src/.
requirements.remaining: Add the phone order side only after a supported native app hook and one authoritative inventory/catalogue path are verified. The existing Hardware Store stock change does not implement online orders.

requirements.requirement: Create a physical Harborline geometry slice automatically after save load.
requirements.remaining: Test automatic generation in game, verify the exact Docks Warehouse record and visual placement. Current pieces are generic Unity cubes, not production models or native registered buildings.

requirements.requirement: Place the district in a valid open site inside the existing Docks region.
evidence: Docks Warehouse property anchor and Physics.CheckBox/Raycast sampling exist in code.
requirements.remaining: No captured runtime property list, Docks bounds, map projection, world transform, navmesh or scene screenshot is available. Candidate radii 42–104m are a heuristic and do not prove that the selected candidate is inside Docks or connected to a road.

requirements.requirement: Connect Harborline roads and pedestrian paths to native road/navigation graph.
evidence: Only primitive road geometry is spawned; no native road graph or NavigationBuilder call is connected.
requirements.remaining: Need exact native road/scene data, navmesh or verified S1MAPI NavigationBuilder integration and in-game path tests.

requirements.requirement: Avoid water, steep terrain and occupied structures.
requirements.remaining: Water filtering is heuristic; generic/unlabelled water colliders can still pass. Test on the real Docks shoreline and add a verified terrain/region boundary check before treating placement as safe.

requirements.requirement: Apply the configured catalogue prices through the game's native item pricing source.
evidence: src/Runtime/HarborlineShopCatalog.cs writes StorableItemDefinition.BasePurchasePrice for the existing vanilla item definition.
The S1API 3.2.2 source for ShopIntegration.CreateListing explicitly warns that customPrice is not applied and uses BasePurchasePrice instead.
requirements.remaining: Run an in-game purchase and compare the visible price and charged amount. This is a shared item-definition price, not a per-store override; verify the effect on every vanilla shop that sells the same item ID.

overallVerdict: The repository contains a buildable native gameplay pilot: two S1API PlayerDealer NPCs, eight S1API customer NPCs with individual customer preferences, and a native Hardware Store catalogue extension using existing vanilla item definitions and the native purchase UI. Ten of the target 42 physical NPCs are now coded. The 30-profile target is not complete; 22 profiles and 32 NPCs remain. A new Harborline storefront, online orders, Realtor-purchasable businesses, map integration, functional interiors, police, persistence, multiplayer and in-game validation remain incomplete or blocked.

validation.caveat: CI success establishes compilation, JSON/package integrity and source tests only. It does not verify Unity/IL2CPP runtime behavior or the actual Docks placement.
validation.nativeNpcAndShopCode: added this development cycle; target game runtime not tested
